title: League results and schedule
description: Every 2026-27 result from Oct 20 to Oct 28 (date, away, home, scores, overtime) plus the league schedule through Nov 20. Oct 20-26 and Oct 28 from Land of Basketball's October scores page (Oct 20-26 checked against StatMuse team points, games played and standings; Lakers-Clippers Oct 28 also matches the StatMuse box score). Oct 27 finals from ESPN (Celtics-Nets, Knicks-Pistons, Spurs-Kings) and VAVEL and Yardbarker (Trail Blazers 136, Lakers 129).

title: Team box score totals
description: Each team's own season totals (minutes, points, FGM, FGA, 3PM, 3PA, FTM, FTA, OREB, DREB, TOV, fouls) for all 30 teams through the Oct 28 games, from Basketball-Reference's 2026-27 season page (revised Oct 29). Every team's games and points match the results file, and league-wide team and opponent sums agree.

title: Opponent box score totals
description: What each team's opponents put up, in season totals, for all 30 teams through the Oct 28 games, from Basketball-Reference's 2026-27 season page (revised Oct 29). Used for defense four factors, possessions and per-100 ratings.

title: Lakers box scores
description: Team lines for both sides of all five Lakers games: Oct 21 and 23 from FantasyData, Oct 25 from Land of Basketball (Jazz rebounds and turnovers as Basketball-Reference's season totals imply), Oct 27 and 28 from StatMuse. The five games add up exactly to Basketball-Reference's Lakers and Lakers-opponent season totals.

title: Player game lines
description: Every Lakers and Warriors player line, game by game, for Game Score form. Land of Basketball box scores (Oct 21-27) and StatMuse (Lakers Oct 28). Each game's player points add up to the final score, and the Lakers' five games add up to Basketball-Reference's season totals. The Warriors' Oct 28 game at Minnesota is not on file yet.

title: Lakers player totals
description: Season totals per Lakers player through Oct 28, from Land of Basketball's per-game table times games played (they add up to the team totals; 2 team turnovers are not credited to players). BPM from Basketball-Reference: 2026-27 (revised Oct 29) where listed, and 2025-26.

title: Lakers quarter scores
description: Points by quarter for both teams in each Lakers game: FantasyData (Oct 21, 23), Land of Basketball (Oct 25, 27), StatMuse (Oct 28). Each game's quarters add up to the final score.

title: Player impact for absences
description: Games, minutes and box plus-minus (this season and last) for every Lakers player and for players on the absences list, used to price absences into projections. Basketball-Reference advanced tables (2026-27 revised Oct 29; 2025-26); Lakers minutes from Land of Basketball.

title: Spotlight storyline notes
description: Short, sourced storyline notes for the next Lakers game (each note names its source and links to it).

title: Key absences
description: Absences confirmed by a cited injury report or news story: team, player, role, dates and source. Not a full league injury list.

title: Lakers 2026-27 schedule
description: All 80 scheduled Lakers games from the SportsBrackets schedule PDF; the 2 NBA Cup dates are not set yet. Matches the league schedule wherever they overlap.

title: NBA teams
description: The 30 teams with their abbreviations and names.

title: NBA.com schedule and scores
description: Every game of the season with final scores once played, from the NBA.com schedule and team game logs. Written by tools/nba on a PC.

title: NBA.com team box scores
description: One row per team per game: shooting, rebounds, turnovers, fouls and minutes. Written by tools/nba on a PC.

title: NBA.com player game lines
description: Every player's box score line in every game. Written by tools/nba on a PC.

title: NBA.com quarter scores
description: Points per quarter for each team in each game. Written by tools/nba on a PC.

title: NBA.com inactive lists
description: Players listed inactive for each game. Written by tools/nba on a PC.
